nextStoryContext: US-004 and beyond are next. All three stories in this PRD (US-001 createLocalIssueOnMain, US-002 real-git integration test, US-003 CLI dispatch) are now complete. The remaining stories are operator-required or future work. The dispatch pattern in index.ts now mirrors dispatchShip: parseIssueArgs returns a discriminated union (mode: text | file-local | help), dispatchIssue routes --file-local to createLocalIssueOnMain via _buildCreateIssueOpts (wraps spawnSync with env/input support), and the text path calls runIssue thin-proxy unchanged.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.stdin is a BunFile (confirmed in Bun File I/O docs). BunFile.text() returns Promise<string> -- matches our dispatchIssue default fileLocalFn which calls await Bun.stdin.text(). API is stable and matches implementation.
